title: 第五章 大闹山门第六章 接受测骨考验
slug: 震惊五星灵帝被逼着撩妹
lines: 杨卤双手抱胸，站在星澜宗山门前，神色从容。
不过几个呼吸的功夫，山门内的石阶上就传来一阵急促的脚步声。七八个穿着星澜宗服饰的弟子鱼贯而出，为首的是一个身材魁梧的中年汉子，手里提着一柄重剑，周身散发着一星灵者大圆满的气息。
“怎么回事？谁在山门前闹事？”那中年汉子一出来就大声喝问。
被杨卤踹飞的那个守门弟子——张海龙，此刻捂着胸口从地上爬起来，指着杨卤，一脸愤怒:“师兄，就是他！这人强行闯山门，还打伤了我！”
中年汉子转头看向杨卤，上下打量了一番，见杨卤只有二星灵王入灵境的修为，嘴角立刻露出一丝不屑:“就你？一个二星灵王入灵境，也敢在星澜宗的地盘撒野？”
杨卤微微一笑:“我本是好意拜师，是这位道友非要拦我，还出言不逊。我只是教教他，什么叫好好说话。”
“教他？”中年汉子冷笑一声，“你算个什么东西，也配教我星澜宗的人？兄弟们，给我把他拿下，废了修为扔下山去！”
话音落下，他身后那七八个弟子立刻拔出兵器，朝杨卤围了上来。
杨卤看着这些人，摇了摇头，叹了口气。
他来拜师是为了做任务攒许愿值复活徐云的，真不想动手。
但这些人非逼他。
“也好。”杨卤低声自语，“既然你们想打，那我就陪你们玩玩。”
他话音刚落，第一个弟子就提着长剑冲了上来，一剑直刺他的胸口。
杨卤身形微微一偏，那剑从他腋下穿过，连他衣角都没碰到。
紧接着，他抬手，轻飘飘一掌拍在那弟子的肩膀上。
那弟子只觉得一股巨力传来，整个人横飞出去，砸在身后的山门石柱上，闷哼一声，直接晕了过去。
其他人全都愣住了。
“什么情况？”
“李师兄怎么一招就……？”
杨卤拍了拍手掌，看向剩下的几个人:“下一个，是谁？”
中年汉子脸色变了。
他本以为杨卤只是个普通的二星灵王，自己这边七八个人围攻，稳赢的局面。
但现在看来，这人根本不是普通的二星灵王！
“一起上！”他大喝一声，自己也提着重剑冲了上去。
六个弟子同时出手，刀剑棍棒齐出，从各个方向朝杨卤攻来。
杨卤站在原地，甚至连位置都没动一下。
他右手抬起，食指轻点，一道纤细的星力化为绳索，从指尖飞射而出，瞬间缠绕住冲在最前面那个弟子的脚踝。
那弟子一个踉跄，直接摔了个狗啃泥。
紧接着，杨卤手腕一转，那道星力绳索像活了一样，又缠住第二个弟子的小腿，将他狠狠拽倒在地。
第三个、第四个、第五个……
短短三个呼吸的时间，六个弟子全部倒地，一个个捂着小腿哀嚎不止，竟是连站都站不起来了。
content_en:
Yang Lu stood in front of the gate of Xinglan Sect with his arms crossed, looking calm.
In just a few breaths, there was a rush of footsteps on the stone steps inside the mountain gate. Seven or eight disciples dressed in Xinglan Sect costumes filed out, led by a burly middle-aged man, holding a heavy sword in his hand, exuding the aura of the Great Perfection of a Star Spirit Master.
"What's going on? Who is making trouble in front of the mountain gate?" The middle-aged man shouted loudly as soon as he came out.
The gatekeeper disciple who was kicked away by Yang Lu, Zhang Hailong, now covered his chest and got up from the ground, pointed at Yang Lu, with an angry look on his face: "Senior brother, it's him! This man forced his way into the mountain gate and even injured me!"
The middle-aged man turned to look at Yang Lu and looked him up and down. Seeing that Yang Lu only had the cultivation level of a two-star spiritual king to enter the spiritual realm, a trace of disdain immediately appeared on his lips: "Just you? A two-star spiritual king who has entered the spiritual realm, dare to run wild on the Xinglan Sect's territory?"
Yang Lu smiled slightly: "I had good intentions to become a disciple, but this fellow Taoist insisted on stopping me and made rude remarks. I just taught him what it means to speak well."
"Teach him?" The middle-aged man sneered, "Who do you think you are, worthy of teaching me, a member of the Xinglan Sect? Brothers, take him down, destroy his cultivation and throw him down the mountain!"
As soon as he finished speaking, the seven or eight disciples behind him drew their weapons and surrounded Yang Lu.
Yang Lu looked at these people, shook his head and sighed.
He came to become a disciple in order to do tasks to save wish points to resurrect Xu Yun, but he really didn't want to do it.
But these people had to force him.
"That's fine." Yang Lu whispered to himself, "Since you want to fight, then I will play with you."
As soon as he finished speaking, the first disciple rushed up with a long sword and pierced his chest with the sword.
Yang Lu turned slightly, and the sword passed through his armpit, not even touching the corner of his clothes.
Then, he raised his hand and lightly patted the disciple on the shoulder.
"Bang!"
The disciple only felt a huge force coming from him. He flew out and hit the stone pillar of the mountain gate behind him. He groaned and fainted.
Everyone else was stunned.
"What's going on?"
"How can Senior Brother Li... with just one move?"
Yang Lu clapped his hands and looked at the remaining people: "Who is next?"
The middle-aged man's expression changed.
He originally thought that Yang Lu was just an ordinary two-star spiritual king, and that he would be surrounded by seven or eight people and that he would win the situation.
But now it seems that this person is not an ordinary two-star spiritual king at all!
"Come together!" he shouted, and he rushed forward with his heavy sword.
The six disciples took action at the same time, with swords and sticks coming out, attacking Yang Lu from all directions.
Yang Lu stood still, not even moving.
He raised his right hand, tapped his index finger, and a slender star power turned into a rope, shot out from his fingertips, and instantly wrapped around the ankle of the disciple who was rushing forward.
The disciple stumbled and fell into the mud.
Immediately afterwards, Yang Lu turned his wrist, and the star power rope seemed to be alive and wrapped around the second disciple's calf, pulling him to the ground.
The third, fourth, fifth...
In just three breaths, all six disciples fell to the ground, each holding their calves and wailing, unable to even stand up.
